'资源搜索：没有记录时没有索引器行，有记录时按条数与展开态': 'Resource search: no indexer row when there are no records; with records it follows the count and expanded state'

'结果表用所属头像和链接站标识别对象，链接名称保留可读回退': 'The results table identifies subjects by their avatar and link site favicon, with a readable fallback for link names'

'只剩一个名字的人也有名字菜单：一行统称，末尾那项是添别名': 'People with only one name still get a name menu: one row for the unified name, with add alias as the last item'
'路由已经取得的实体资料直接用于首屏，作品和照片仍并行取齐': 'Entity data already fetched by the router feeds the first screen directly, while videos and photos still fetch in parallel to completion'

'本机检测失败时保留网络方式，重新检测后可以选择本机播放器': 'A failed local detection keeps the network method; after re-detecting, the local player becomes selectable'

'发现按范围读取，清除文字和标签恢复列表，卡片打开对应详情': 'Discovery reads by scope, clearing text and tags restores the list, and cards open their details'

'按下项跟着当前区走，点一项回到壳的 openManage': 'The pressed item follows the current section, and clicking one hands off to openManage in the shell'
'句柄 render 返回时标题已是新内容，不等下一次渲染': 'By the time the handle render returns, the title already shows the new content, with no wait for the next render'

'从回收站后退到首页重掷取样种子，并让壳作废顶部三层的缓存': 'Going back from trash to home rerolls the sampling seed and asks the shell to invalidate the top three layers\' caches'
'壳认领写地址只重取，不重建筛选；同一个地址再写一次也重取': 'A shell-claimed address write only refetches and never rebuilds filters; writing the same address again refetches too'

'浏览器自己的取消（Esc 关模态）先拦下，再走同一条关闭': 'The browser\'s own cancel (Escape closing the modal) is intercepted first, then the same close path runs'

'封面取不到就把图摘掉，兜底文字还在，卡片其余部分照常显示': 'When a cover cannot be fetched the image is removed, the fallback text stays, and the rest of the card renders as usual'
'缓慢读取期间的下一项结果排队刷新，不取消读取且不遗漏新值': 'While a slow read runs, next-item results queue up to refresh without canceling the read or dropping new values'
'判过的行从缓存里摘掉并同步计数，不为一次判定重取整条队列': 'Reviewed rows come out of the cache with counts synced, and one verdict never refetches the whole queue'
'批量通过逐条沿用服务端版本回执，并保留其他写入造成的冲突': 'Bulk approval reuses the server\'s per-row version receipts and keeps conflicts caused by other writes'
'Cookie 文件超过上限时当场拦住，不拿它去占一次请求': 'An oversized cookie file is blocked on the spot instead of spending a request on it'

'按下态照当前语境的筛选画，点下去交给壳；脱盘的来源点不了': 'Pressed states paint per the current context\'s filters and clicks go to the shell; dead sources are not clickable'
'看过那一层有播放时间的两张热力图，指到一格读数换成那一格': 'The watched layer has two play-time heatmaps, and pointing at a cell swaps the reading to that cell'
'径向图超过六段并掉尾部，体积跟着合计；负数与非有限值不画': 'The radial chart merges the tail past six segments with volume following the sum; negatives and non-finite values never paint'

'初值与壳启动之前一致：口径还没写入，来处指向首页与关注页': 'Initial values match pre-shell-startup: the convention is not written yet, and origins point at home and follows'
'小窗放着别的条目时打开另一条：先拆小窗里那一个，再挂新的': 'Opening another item while the mini window holds a different one: the mini window\'s item tears down first, then the new one mounts'

'更换资料与缓存的存放位置，按流程迁移并重启。媒体文件目录单独配置。': 'Change where details and the cache live and follow the flow to migrate and restart. Media file directories are configured separately.'

'多个筛选条件会共同缩小结果。找不到内容时先检查媒体库和筛选条件。': 'Several filters narrow results together. When nothing turns up, check the library scope and filters first.'

'按番号、出演者和厂牌查找已入库的作品，可以选择官方封面或预览图。': 'Find ingested titles by code, cast, or label, choosing between the official cover and a preview image.'

'允许按处理规则读取视频信息与生成预览，适合本机磁盘或不计费挂载。': 'Allows reading video information and generating previews per the processing rules; suits local disks or unmetered mounts.'
'将云端目标对应到 Peach 能扫描的挂载路径，便于下载后入库。': 'Maps the cloud target onto a mount path Peach can scan, so downloads ingest smoothly.'
'尚未取得可演示的视频或对应控件。请先添加视频，或跳过后稍后重看。': 'No demonstrable video or its controls yet. Add a video first, or skip and revisit later.'
'当前配置表单有编辑内容。请先处理表单，再开启需要切换页面的章节。': 'The current settings form has unsaved edits. Deal with the form before opening a section that switches pages.'
'续页复用，dropBars 之后重取，状态页空页照样退回全库口径': 'Follow-up pages reuse the host, refetch after dropBars, and an empty status page still falls back to the whole-library scope'
'后继任务使用自身任务号控制，服务端未提供能力的父任务没有控制按钮': 'Follow-up tasks are controlled by their own task id; parents whose server side lacks the capability get no control button'
`${label} 下教程中心可阅读、关闭与重开，不提交业务写入`: `Under ${label} the tutorial center can be read, dismissed, and reopened without submitting any business writes`
'发现页按口味推荐作品。在这里切换馆藏或外部内容，并按标签筛选。': 'Discover recommends titles by taste. Switch between library and external content here and filter by tag.'
'在这里切换浏览器记录与 Peach 观看评价，分析各自的口味。': 'Switch between browser history and Peach watch ratings here; each is analyzed for taste on its own.'
'教程进度未保存到本机账本，其他设备尚未同步。请重新读取后继续。': 'Tour progress was not saved to this machine\'s ledger and other devices have not synced it. Reload before continuing.'
'分区依次是运行信息、新手教程、卸载；缺依赖的运行信息带下载链接': 'Sections run runtime info, guided tour, uninstall; runtime info missing a dependency carries a download link'
`首个选项前出现 ${segments.inset}px 空白`: `${segments.inset}px of blank space appears before the first option`
'喜欢的外部作品可以加入想要清单；在这里切换馆藏、发现与想要。': 'External titles you like can join the want list; switch between library, discover, and wants here.'
'决定详情中显示多少项相关推荐。口味和记录来源在口味页面管理。': 'Decides how many related recommendations the details page shows. Taste and record sources are managed on the taste page.'
'设置开机启动、仅启动托盘和桌面快捷方式。可用选项随平台变化。': 'Sets launch at login, tray-only startup, and desktop shortcuts. Available options vary by platform.'
'文件夹是实际存放媒体的位置；多个文件夹可以归到同一个媒体库。': 'Folders are where media actually lives; several folders can belong to one library.'
'将来源通知里的路径换算为 Peach 能访问的媒体目录路径。': 'Translates paths from source notifications into media directory paths Peach can reach.'
'授权用户脚本连接；更新后需要重新配对，关闭后停止使用该功能。': 'Authorizes the userscript to connect; a pairing redo is needed after updates, and turning it off stops the feature.'
'独立控制馆藏及口味信息的上传，启用前查看当前上传预览并确认。': 'Controls library and taste detail uploads independently; review the current upload preview and confirm before enabling.'
'将停止这轮剩余的处理及其后续任务。已保存的资料和结果会保留。': 'This stops the rest of this round\'s processing and its follow-up tasks. Saved details and results are kept.'
'到达末尾不代表完成，缺失步骤从未读位置继续，全部已读才可重看': 'Reaching the end is not completion; missing steps resume from the first unread position, and a replay is possible only once everything is read'
'资源采样中和未取得分别显示，原因优先说明，不把null填成零': 'Resource sampling-in-progress and not-obtained display separately, the reason is explained first, and null is never coerced to zero'
'取消任务先复用确认框，初始聚焦取消，未确认或关闭弹窗都不提交': 'Task cancellation reuses the confirm dialog, focus starts on cancel, and neither an unconfirmed nor a dismissed dialog submits'
'父任务结束后仍可控制整批后继，未展示的后继也属于同一操作范围': 'The whole batch of follow-ups stays controllable after the parent ends, including follow-ups not shown — one operation covers them all'
'同类父任务有独立控制范围时分别显示，按钮只提交对应的父任务号': 'When same-kind parents have independent control scopes they display separately, and a button submits only its own parent task id'
'macOS 独立包没有应用内安装，给本机架构的安装镜像下载键': 'The macOS standalone package has no in-app install; the download button serves the install image for this machine\'s architecture'
'走开时保留管理区宿主供目标页面切换，提交阶段没有同步提交告警': 'Walking away keeps the manage-area host alive for the target page to switch into; the submit stage raises no synchronous submit alert'
'未归属随首页位置保留，撤掉筛选后取全库，后退恢复未归属缓存': 'Unfiled items keep the home position, dropping the filter falls back to the whole library, and going back restores the unfiled cache'
'在目录页里换筛选保留新作与宿主；设置里改了合集开关重取一次': 'Changing filters on the catalog page keeps the new releases and the host; toggling the collection switch in settings refetches exactly once'
'资源搜索使用配置的索引器。查到结果后还需要你主动选择下载。': 'Resource search uses the configured indexers. Once results appear, choosing to download stays in your hands.'
'选择中文或日文名称；偏好跟随馆藏，其他设备读取同一份设置。': 'Choose between Chinese and Japanese names; the preference follows the library, and other devices read the same setting.'
'检查当前可用版本。下载与重启安装分别执行，按页面状态操作。': 'Checks the currently available version. Downloading and the restart install run separately; follow the page state.'
'从需要关注的项目进入原因与恢复入口；没有异常时查看库健康。': 'Attention-needed items open the reason and recovery entries; with nothing wrong, review the library health instead.'
'说明目录来自本机磁盘还是网盘挂载，用于选择合适的读取行为。': 'States whether a directory is a local disk or a cloud mount, which picks the right read behavior.'
'控制九宫格和预览缓存的生成；读取行为同时受媒体库规则约束。': 'Controls contact-sheet and preview cache generation; read behavior also follows the library rules.'
'活动任务按服务端给出的动作暂停、继续和取消，并重新读取进度': 'Active tasks pause, resume, and cancel through the actions the server reports, then reread progress'
'等待期间旧内容隐藏并禁用，新列表到达后解除忙态并换成新卡片': 'While waiting, the old content hides and disables; when the new list lands the busy state lifts and the new cards take over'
'筛选提交不提前定位，props 动作身份固定且选择快照独立': 'Filter submits do not navigate early, the props action identity stays fixed, and the selection snapshot is independent'
'refresh 按 URL 恢复筛选，当前宿主复用原有代次': 'refresh restores filters from the URL and the current host reuses the original generation'
`首次切换应经过中间位置；逐帧位置/高度：${trace}`: `The first toggle must pass through the middle position; per-frame position/height: ${trace}`
'JAV 读数尚未返回时保持两行骨架，内容就绪后再决定合行': 'While the JAV reading has not returned, a two-line skeleton holds; the merge is decided once content is ready'
'工具页标题采用 medium，链接读数使用既定字号与行高': 'Tool page headings use medium; link readings use the established size and line height'
'清理文件名，按模板改名和归档；先预览，执行后可整批退回。': 'Cleans filenames, renaming and filing by template; preview first, and a whole batch can be reverted after running.'
'选择标签继续浏览相关馆藏；本地与在线使用不同的标签词表。': 'Pick a tag to keep browsing the related library; local and online use different tag vocabularies.'
'先按分类找到待复核资料，再查看项目的来源和证据后作决定。': 'First locate pending details by category, then read each item\'s sources and evidence before deciding.'
'控制向 CloudDrive 接口发出请求时的网络连接。': 'Controls the network connection used for CloudDrive API requests.'
'授权 Peach 使用该索引器；按索引器提供的信息填写。': 'Authorizes Peach to use that indexer; fill in what the indexer gives you.'
'指定 Peach 使用的代理；已保存时留空保留当前地址。': 'Sets the proxy Peach uses; leave empty to keep the saved address.'
'导览已结束，但完成状态未保存。请重新读取教程状态后再试。': 'The tour ended but its completion was not saved. Reload the tour state and try again.'
'播放器导览抑制片源与自动播放，结束后沿用已保存的播放偏好': 'The player tour suppresses sources and autoplay; after it ends the saved playback preferences apply'
'内部滚动、窗口变化和目标重挂载后刷新位置，结束时清理跟踪': 'Position refreshes on internal scrolling, window changes, and target remounts; the tracking cleans up when done'
'取消优先于在途的 %s 请求，迟到回执不覆盖真实取消结果': 'Cancellation wins over an in-flight %s request; a late receipt never overwrites the real cancel outcome'
'未知总量的任务处于 %s 时展示真实状态，不显示推进动画': 'A task with unknown total shows its real state while %s and plays no progress animation'
'检查官网、社交账号和资料站链接，复核并清理失效地址。': 'Check official sites, social accounts, and details-site links; review and clean dead addresses.'
'按女优勾选并永久删除关联影片，执行前确认范围与影响。': 'Check performers to permanently delete their tied titles; confirm the scope and impact before running.'
'决定打开作品详情时是否直接播放。需要安静浏览时关闭。': 'Decides whether opening a title plays it right away. Turn off for quiet browsing.'
'过滤新作中的单人合集，只影响新作展示，馆藏仍可查找。': 'Filters single-performer compilations out of new releases; it only affects the new-release view and the library stays searchable.'
'决定是否定期查询已启用来源的新内容；修改后自动保存。': 'Decides whether enabled sources are polled for new content on a schedule; changes save automatically.'
'决定提交到 PikPak 的内容保存到哪个云端目录。': 'Decides which cloud directory PikPak submissions land in.'
'确认用户脚本已安装，并与当前 Peach 服务连接。': 'Confirms the userscript is installed and connected to the current Peach service.'
'换页步骤给出真实操作路径，设置与数据管理保留必要层级': 'The page steps give real operation paths while settings and data management keep their necessary hierarchy'
'快速导览在首页四步结束，详细章节都可以从主题目录找到': 'The quick tour ends with four steps on the home page; every detailed chapter is reachable from the topic directory'
'保存只发送当前动作，不用本设备快照覆盖其他设备的章节': 'Saving sends only the current action and never overwrites other devices\' chapters with this device\'s snapshot'
'首次邀请框选教程按钮并保留入口的键盘操作，遮罩可关闭': 'The first invitation spotlights the tour button while keeping keyboard access to the entry, and the overlay can be dismissed'
'目标仍在等待时 Escape 与外部导航都能结束会话': 'While the target is still waiting, both Escape and external navigation end the session'
'真实零读数可见，高占用由该指标的真实high状态强调': 'A true zero reading stays visible, and heavy use is emphasized by that metric\'s real high state'
'确认取消的请求忙态阻止重复提交，失败留在弹窗内供重试': 'The confirm-cancel request\'s busy state blocks double submits, and a failure stays inside the dialog for retry'
'首页不读取资源扫描，进入二级页后才按已配置根目录读取': 'The home page never reads resource scans; only a second-level page reads the configured roots'
'Esc 和拖出导航区域取消排序，不保存也不触发导航': 'Esc and dragging out of the navigation area cancel reordering — nothing is saved and no navigation fires'
'关注页往返复用已加载内容，不重新取列表或铺首屏骨架': 'The follows page reuses loaded content on both ways in and never refetches the list or lays the first-screen skeleton'
'核对文件与馆藏记录，检查失效条目、空文件夹和缓存。': 'Reconciles files against library records, checking dead entries, empty folders, and the cache.'
'将同一作品的分卷和版本集中显示；播放时在详情选择。': 'Groups a title\'s parts and versions together; pick one on the details page when playing.'
'过滤新作中的大合集，只影响新作展示，馆藏仍可查找。': 'Filters large compilations out of new releases; it only affects the new-release view and the library stays searchable.'
'地址定位服务，令牌授权 Peach 调用服务接口。': 'The address locates the service; the token authorizes Peach to call its API.'
'移除确认范围内的生成文件或旧备份，执行前核对清单。': 'Removes generated files or old backups inside the confirmed scope; read the list before running.'
'读取或保存失败向调用方报告，不当成空进度或写入成功': 'Read or save failures are reported to the caller, never mistaken for empty progress or a successful write'
'主任务和后继使用带准确名称、提示和编辑键的图标控制': 'Both the main task and follow-ups use icon controls with accurate names, tooltips, and edit keys'
'立即显示目标骨架，异步名单和重读回执尊重页面取消权': 'The target skeleton shows immediately, while async rosters and reread receipts respect the page\'s right to cancel'
'处理播放卡顿或打不开的视频，修复时间戳表和索引。': 'Fixes videos that stutter or refuse to open by repairing timestamp tables and indexes.'
'过滤新作中的切片，只影响新作展示，馆藏仍可查找。': 'Filters clips out of new releases; it only affects the new-release view and the library stays searchable.'
'帮助在侧栏与卡片上区分内容；名称不改变文件路径。': 'Helps tell content apart in the sidebar and on cards; the name never changes file paths.'
'限制自动读取视频，适合读取会消耗计费流量的挂载。': 'Limits automatic video reads, suiting mounts where reading burns metered traffic.'
'保存后，能连接到 Peach 的设备可直接进入。': 'Once saved, any device that can reach Peach gets in directly.'
'本章已结束，未显示的步骤尚未完成，可以稍后继续。': 'This chapter has ended; steps not shown are unfinished and can be continued later.'
'扫描按钮保留最终尺寸与变体，在数据就绪前不能操作': 'The scan button keeps its final size and variant and cannot be used before the data is ready'
'已读与跳过互斥，重看不重复计数，其他章节保持原状': 'Read and skip are mutually exclusive, a replay never counts twice, and other chapters stay untouched'
'重开只通知入口，不重置学习或安装状态，不发送请求': 'Reopening only notifies the entry; it never resets learning or install state and sends no requests'
'挂载前的请求交付一次，卸载后的入口不接收排队请求': 'Requests before mount are delivered once, and an unmounted entry never receives queued requests'
'骨架或 inert 区域不作为目标，显示后可定位': 'Skeletons and inert areas are never targets, and once shown the target is locatable'
'默认选项不重试，挂载只重取已失效查询，离线也照发': 'The default option never retries, remounting only refetches stale queries, and going offline still sends'
'父任务的后继取消后在卡片上直接显示取消状态及数量': 'After a parent\'s follow-ups are cancelled, the card shows the cancelled state and counts directly'
'认领的写地址不重开，返回已访问地址重挂时使用缓存': 'A claimed write address never reopens, and remounting a previously visited address uses the cache'
'任务结果成功绿、失败和取消红、中断黄，排队中性': 'Task results: green for success, red for failure and cancellation, yellow for interruption, neutral for queued'
'选择浅色、深色或跟随系统；适合不同光线下阅读。': 'Pick light, dark, or follow the system; each reads well under different lighting.'
'决定进入列表时先看什么；随机排序不区分升降序。': 'Decides what you see first when opening a list; random order ignores ascending and descending.'
'大图便于看封面，密集显示便于一次浏览更多作品。': 'Large images show covers off; the dense grid shows more titles at once.'
'离开详情时用小窗继续观看；需要专注浏览时关闭。': 'Keeps watching in the mini-player when you leave the details page; turn it off for focused browsing.'
'决定提交到 115 的内容保存到哪个云端目录。': 'Decides which cloud directory 115 submissions land in.'
'查看本次会包含的内容，再决定是否启用明细上传。': 'See exactly what an upload would include before deciding to enable detail uploads.'
'所选影片及关联记录已删除，女优档案和照片保留。': 'The selected titles and their linked records are deleted; performer profiles and photos are kept.'
'先用 4 步认识常用入口，其余功能用到时再看。': 'Four steps introduce the common entries; everything else can wait until you need it.'
导览期间不自动播放；退出后仍按原来的播放设置使用。: Nothing autoplays during the tour; after it ends the original playback settings apply.
'未取得安装状态。可以重试，或直接打开对应页面。': 'The install state could not be obtained. Retry, or open the matching page directly.'
'旧快照未提供resources时不伪造资源指标': 'Never fabricates resource metrics when an old snapshot lacks resources'
'服务端未给出控制能力时不按任务种类自行增加按钮': 'Adds no control button by task kind when the server grants no capability'
'换一位先按地址显示骨架，资料取回后使用规范名字': 'Switching people shows a skeleton by address first, then the canonical name once details arrive'
'在所有设备上恢复右上角教程入口，保留已读进度': 'Brings the tour entry back to the top bar on every device and keeps your reading progress'
'运行 Peach 的电脑 · 确认后保存配置': 'The computer running Peach · confirm to save the configuration'
'一次应用一组配色和参数，适合先挑选整体外观。': 'Applies one set of colors and parameters at a time — good for picking an overall look first.'
'控制光晕纹理中的颗粒感；需要平滑背景时降低。': 'Controls the grain in the glow texture; lower it for a smoother background.'
'选择生成预览时的解码方式；播放转码另行设置。': 'Picks the decoder used to generate previews; playback transcoding is set separately.'
'允许发现事件触发入库；关闭后按需要手动扫描。': 'Lets discovery events trigger ingestion; with it off, scan manually as needed.'
'决定新加入的关注来源回看多久；跟随馆藏保存。': 'Decides how far back newly followed sources look; saved with the library.'
'采用运行 Peach 的电脑提供的代理配置。': 'Uses the proxy configuration from the computer running Peach.'
'运行 Peach 的电脑 · 修改后自动保存': 'The computer running Peach · changes save automatically'
'这批后续任务取消后不能继续，需要时重新发起。': 'Once this batch of follow-ups is cancelled it cannot continue; start it again when needed.'
'连接渠道、设置目标目录，按需要配对用户脚本。': 'Connect a channel, set the target directory, and pair the userscript as needed.'
'缺失目标有等待期限，取消等待后没有遗留计时器': 'A missing target has a wait deadline, and after the wait is cancelled no timer is left behind'
'任务控制请求等待时保持按钮焦点并阻止重复提交': 'While a task-control request waits, the button keeps focus and double submits are blocked'
'任务控制失败保留原状态和原因，可以在原位重试': 'A failed task control keeps the original state and reason, retryable in place'
'打开教程仅调用入口，不发送写入请求或操作回执': 'Opening the tour only calls the entry; it sends no write requests or operation receipts'
'离开目录保留网格宿主，由目标页面切换可见表面': 'Leaving the catalog keeps the grid host alive, and the target page switches the visible surface'

/* The pages rendered by the router and:
/* The pages rendered by the router and the in-page components inside them (ADR-0031, "pages and the in-page components inside
 * pages are rendered only by the router tree"): the shell decides when to open and when to tear down, the React route tree renders.
 *
 * Pages render into three containers of the shell: the management body `#stats`, the `#index` shared by the index and profile
 * pages, and the `#grid` shared by the catalog grid and the junk queue. In-page components have their own containers: home
 * filter bar `#catalogFilter`, home new-releases row `#feedNew`, top-bar search dropdown `#searchMenu`. A container holds one
 * page (or surface) at a time and each container keeps its own state: when the profile page renders into `#index`, the
 * management page is merely hidden by the shell and stays alive (pages with polling keep fetching on their original cadence);
 * only when the shell next claims a surface (`claimSurface`) are `#stats` and `#index` taken down together. `#grid` is not part
 * of that: changing filters inside the catalog also claims the surface, because the grid must stay rendered. In-page components
 * are taken down by the shell per their own route criteria; the search dropdown is never taken down. A page follows the entry
 * registered here, not address matching: when the details stage stacks on a page the address is `/assets/:id`, and the page
 * must stay.
 *
 * Resident components (batch bar, color card, management header, immersive mode, settings panel, sidebar, stage) are not tied
 * to a page and open through `openResidentSurface`: no first-screen fetch, always counting as the current page, the host being
 * that resident node itself. They are never torn down; only an error boundary unmounts their component, and only the component,
 * not the host.
 *
 * The registration key is the "surface": pages use paths (`/stats`, `/performers/*`, `/`), in-page and resident components use
 * names (`search`, `batch-dock`); the two never overlap, and the route tree looks the same group of tables up by key
 * (`react/router/managed-routes.tsx`).
 *
